title: Triangulatedness for a chosen finite-extension shift
statement: For l, E, L, ι and X satisfying the hypotheses of [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core], and for any CommShift c on integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X, that functor is IsTriangulated.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing theorem exposes the final triangulatedness transport for this selected finite-extension localization functor; the strict Roos cone and finite-free exactness are the remaining argument.

from.place: Paragraphs 1-5: finite-free Roos cones, signed shifts, and localization transport.

proof.text: Apply Functor.isTriangulated_of_precomp to the derived quotient, using the precomposition triangulatedness theorem and the quotient essential-surjectivity of arrows.
